title: Residual Dominance as a Structural Account of Last-Item Reliance in Causal Self-Attention Recommenders
abstract: arXiv:2608.14021v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer-based sequential recommenders with causal self-attention often rely heavily on the most recent interaction at inference time, but how this behavior is structurally expressed in the representation used for prediction remains unclear. We combine prediction-time diagnostics with norm-based analysis of the full attention block. First, we show that SASRec-style models exhibit highly localized last-item reliance. We then find that, although self-attention aggregates contextual information, residual addition sharply shifts the full-block representation toward same-position contributions, which we term residual dominance. To probe this interpretation, we use inference-time residual scaling as a controlled diagnostic intervention. translated_title: 残差主导性：因果自注意力推荐器中最后一项依赖的结构性解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14021v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：基于Transformer的序列推荐器，采用因果自注意力机制，在推理时往往严重依赖最近一次交互，但这种行为在用于预测的表示中如何结构性表达仍不清楚。我们将预测时诊断与整个注意力模块的范数分析相结合。首先，我们表明SASRec类模型表现出高度局部化的最后一项依赖。然后，我们发现，尽管自注意力聚合了上下文信息，但残差加法使整个模块的表示显著偏向于同位置贡献，我们将其称为残差主导性。为了验证这一解释，我们使用推理时残差缩放作为受控诊断干预。改变残差强度会导致结构混合与最后一项依赖之间的单调权衡，而降低残差强度则能恢复一部分最终位置遗漏，而这些遗漏的表示是……
tldr: 本文提出“残差主导性”概念，揭示因果自注意力推荐器中最后一项依赖的结构根源，并通过残差缩放干预实现可控权衡与诊断改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "residual dominance" to explain the structural origin of last-item reliance in causal self-attention recommenders, and uses residual scaling as a diagnostic intervention to control the trade-off and recover missed final-position predictions.
